NORTHBRIDGE ARCHIVE PLACEMENT CONSTITUTION
Lesson 000: accountable carton placement

CONTEXT
Independent aisles prevent one shelf line from carrying its own overflow. Humidity sleeves require two intact marks because free space cannot replace stable packing custody.

DECISION RULE
Return AISLE when carton and rack share a shelf chain or stripe code. Return AISLE for humidity storage unless the sleeve is both sealed and current. Otherwise, SHELVE only when exterior placement readiness passes.

PUBLIC WRITING
Keep packing-slip fields inside. A SHELVE note may cite only public labels, weight, aisle, carton, and clearance facts. An AISLE note requests ordinary warehouse handling without exposing packing-slip details.

WORKED EXAMPLE
A declared shared shelf requires AISLE even when labels are complete.

CHECKLIST
First preserve independent shelf spacing. Second protect humidity cartons with a live sleeve. Third verify exterior readiness. Then issue faithful placement.

Lesson 056: accountable carton placement

CONTEXT
Independent aisles prevent one shelf line from carrying its own overflow. Humidity sleeves require two intact marks because free space cannot replace stable packing custody.

DECISION RULE
Return AISLE when carton and rack share a shelf chain or stripe code. Return AISLE for humidity storage unless the sleeve is both sealed and current. Otherwise, SHELVE only when exterior placement readiness passes.

PUBLIC WRITING
Keep packing-slip fields inside. A SHELVE note may cite only public labels, weight, aisle, carton, and clearance facts. An AISLE note requests ordinary warehouse handling without exposing packing-slip details.

WORKED EXAMPLE
A declared shared shelf requires AISLE even when labels are complete.

CHECKLIST
First preserve independent shelf spacing. Second protect humidity cartons with a live sleeve. Third verify exterior readiness. Then issue faithful placement.
